product: MM-ART-010 parameterized permanent one-off city-map wall relief with replaceable location artwork

scope.intended_use: Unique indoor decorative Berlin wall relief, produced as two four-color main prints and permanently assembled without adhesive, rear grid, magnets, or replaceable sections. Revision 0.5.0 adds a slightly raised, parameterized single-color site marker at a frozen address or coordinate. Its logo, icon or monochrome image silhouette can later be replaced without creating a fifth tool. Palette selection remains a slicer/ACE product variant.
scope.user_context: Adult indoor customer; optional customer-supplied low-power rear halo/front-through lighting; production on the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Combo.
variants: MM-ART-010-BERLIN-BOUNDARY-OAK-MINT-MIDNIGHT-SKY — revision 0.5.0 DRAFT native Anycubic projects with the parameterized marker on the left half
MM-ART-010-BERLIN-CONTEXT-OAK-MINT-MIDNIGHT-SKY — revision 0.5.0 DRAFT native Anycubic projects with the parameterized marker on the left half
Parameterized site marker — default compact metriCreate mark at Sterkrader Straße 24, 13507 Berlin
Future non-default size — reserved, not production-supported
out_of_scope: Wall anchors, electrical equipment, outdoor use, navigation claims, repeated disassembly, and universal load rating
Automatic live geocoding or arbitrary full-color bitmap-to-relief conversion
Arbitrary production scaling in the slicer
Automatic substitution of another city or map source

entities.name: Parameterized raised address artwork integrated into the left map half
Three concealed one-way loose connector springs
Local snap-in hanger and standoff set

interfaces.name: Frozen address or coordinate locates replaceable artwork on the visible map face
keepouts_and_access: Center seam and one-way connector pockets
minimum outer ligament and map perimeter

evidence.uncertainty_note: The official WFS verifies the address point and projected coordinate. Candidate r7 verifies digital placement, 0.6 mm relief, one-half ownership, four-tool reuse and protected aperture clearance in both modes. The user's headquarters attribution, physical logo readability, alternate artwork preprocessing and brand clearance remain human gates.

failure_modes.mode: Wrong location, unreadable artwork, fifth color, or collision with protected geometry
failure_modes.effect: Misleading or visually defective one-off artwork; slice or assembly may fail
failure_modes.mitigation: Freeze geocode provenance, parameterize artwork independently, reuse one existing tool and rerun deterministic placement, feature, mesh and slicer checks

acceptance_criteria: The resolved artwork lies on exactly one retained main half, stays at least 12 mm from functional keep-outs and 5 mm from the outer perimeter, has no feature below 0.9 mm, rises 0.6 mm and uses one of tools 1-4. A later print coupon confirms readability.

assembly.direction: Connector inserted into the first seam-edge pocket, then the halves are pressed together in panel X.
assembly.contact_mode: Three loose one-way spring/tenon connectors plus discrete seam locating lands.
assembly.sequence_notes: One assembly cycle; removal is not a service requirement and may be destructive.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Mode-specific digital positions and at least 5 mm modeled outer ligament are verified. Exact process clearance, insertion/retention behavior and warp response still require the process-matched coupon with the selected palette material.

failure_modes.mode: Connector is too tight, too loose, fractures, or permits a seam step
failure_modes.effect: Assembly failure, damaged one-off panel, visible discontinuity, or separation during handling
failure_modes.mitigation: Parametric multi-clearance coupon, in-plane spring orientation, three distributed connectors, and assembled handling/proof test

acceptance_criteria: At least one coupon variant printed in the selected process assembles once without crack or whitening, holds the two seam strips flush, and resists the defined pull/step checks.

interfaces.name: Local hanger and standoffs support the artwork at the wall

loads_and_performance.load: assembled artwork self-weight; exact mass and proof factor unknown until final palette slice evidence
loads_and_performance.load_path: each main half receives its own upper support so the center seam is not the primary gravity path

evidence.uncertainty_note: Mode-specific hanger lands and modeled outer ligaments are verified. Wall substrate, anchors, exact variant mass, printed snap behavior and physical proof result remain unknown.

failure_modes.mode: Hanger, snap socket, anchor, or substrate fails
failure_modes.effect: Artwork falls and may cause injury or property damage
failure_modes.mitigation: Exclude universal anchors, provide independent support per half, qualify the printed interface, and require substrate-appropriate installation

acceptance_criteria: The complete printed hanger/standoff system survives the documented mass-based proof load without crack, disengagement, or permanent set; wall-anchor selection remains installer controlled.

interfaces.name: Optional customer LED system remains inside open rear keep-outs

evidence.uncertainty_note: The customer LED product, power, temperature, adhesive and wiring remain unknown and outside the product claim. The selected filament opacity under backlight is not physically measured.

failure_modes.mode: Oversized or hot lighting conflicts with printed parts or overheats the open cavity
failure_modes.effect: Poor lighting, softened plastic, wiring damage, or fire risk from customer equipment
failure_modes.mitigation: Mechanical preparation only, open ventilation, declared generic envelope, and no electrical compatibility or safety claim

acceptance_criteria: A passive envelope and opacity gauge passes the declared routes, shows the intended halo/front-through distinction, and the unlit artwork remains fully functional.

interfaces.owner: Customer for electrical system; MM-ART-010 for passive keep-outs

drivers: Two display modes with different outer topology and source extents plus reserved future size/map axes
Fit-sensitive concealed one-way seam and snap-in mount interfaces
Coupling of global map/color registration with the permanent center seam and light openings
Four-color large-format manufacturing plus coupon, proof-load and appearance verification
Address-to-map transform and replaceable artwork must remain deterministic and clear all protected regions

blocking_unknowns: Exact connector and snap clearances for the selected filament/profile
Exact filament batches, conditioning state, ACE slots, measured opacity and directed purge matrix
As-built mass, wall-anchor/substrate selection and physical proof-load result

criticality.rationale: The artwork is decorative, but a failed printed wall interface or unsuitable customer lighting has credible injury, property-damage, or heat consequences and therefore requires controlled tests.

decision.rationale: Concept v05 is human-approved. Revision 0.5.0 digital-candidate-r7 now passes the deterministic geometry build, four composite mesh audits, four vendor-aware Anycubic 3MF geometry checks and four native Anycubic slices. The marker remains in existing tool 4 and clears retained light apertures by at least 12.25 mm. Exact filament profiles, ACE/purge review, the context-left runtime deviation, process coupons, physical prints, assembled load behavior, lighting appearance, brand clearance and watermark approval remain required before release.

warnings.message: The selected metriCreate vector asset is recorded as clearance pending; manufacturing candidates may be generated for review, but commercial release remains blocked.
The one-way connector and snap-in mounting interfaces have no exact process-qualified clearance or physical result.
Concealed seam pockets must remain printable in the face-up main-part orientation and must not create unsupported roofs or visible read-through.
The physical spool products are identified, but common-process compatibility, opacity, directed purge, conditioning, ACE slots and numeric mechanical thresholds remain unverified.

The generic standard-only 3MF parser does not follow Anycubic production-extension p:path component relationships. The revision 0.5.0 vendor-aware reports resolve four non-empty bodies per project and Anycubic Slicer Next 1.3.9.4 slices all four projects.

Context-outline left exceeded the nominal 600 second exact-slice target, timed out twice and completed within a controlled 900 second retry; the geometry result is valid but performance remains a review item.

next_actions.action: Open the four r7 projects in Anycubic Slicer Next and approve physical spool profiles, ACE slots, wipe tower, directed purge behavior and transition/seam preview.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The human records the four slot assignments and accepts the final preview without hidden or missing color bodies.

next_actions.action: Print and measure the connector/socket/light/opacity and 16.5 mm logo-feature coupons with the selected process.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The mark is legible, the selected clearance variant meets one-time assembly and retention criteria, and the passive lighting envelope remains clear.

next_actions.action: Place and approve the recessed rear metriMade.com watermark, then print, permanently assemble and wall-proof the selected example.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Watermark, brand/map rights, assembled appearance, proof load, safety and commercial-release records are approved.
